## Verdict
needs-revision

## Concerns
- claim-1 is not established: the full degree-\(d+3\) row lattice is not shown to equal the selected-row lattice, so omitted Pieri rows may impose a residual relation on \(\bar x_3\).
- claim-2 is unsupported: the report does not transcribe the required complete column/row lists, complementary minors, and integral row-dependency certificates. It also must state \((A_+J)_d=0\).

## Unresolved certificates
- [proof-attempt] For every \(p=1\) and \(c=1\) boundary regime, provide the complete degree-\(d,\ldots,d+3\) column and Pieri-row matrices, the claimed unimodular complementary minor, and an explicit integral identity \(R_{\mathrm{full}}=CR_{\mathrm{selected}}\). This must include every omitted row and thereby prove that no residual relation on \(x_3\) remains.
